thresholds: stable / wrapped / staked / stale / low-volatility coin nahi; daily ATR zaroori
LONG band jab BTC kamzor (4H downtrend + daily EMA50 ke neeche, ya 24h ≤ −3%) · SHORT band jab BTC mazboot (daily+4H uptrend, ya 24h ≥ +3%) jab tak coin khud bohat kamzor na ho
trend: 4H trend = side, daily ulta nahi, 1H move side ke khilaf 0.5% se zyada nahi · mean-rev: daily ulta nahi
EMA20 se 2 ATR ya toote level se 1.5 ATR se zyada door nahi · LONG RSI ≤ 72 (4H ≤ 78) · SHORT RSI ≥ 28 (4H ≥ 22)
SL 1.5 ATR (max 15%), TP 2.5 ATR (max 25%) ya ulta zone — R:R ≥ 1.5 · +1R par SL entry par
stop-loss ke baad 12h usi coin par entry nahi · 6h mein ulti side (flip) nahi
jis signal type ke ≥ 20 closed trades aur win rate < 45% ho, woh ruk jata hai (khud se kabhi dobara nahi khulta)
note: Win rate = pichle paper results, future ki guarantee nahi. Gate filters pehle se tay shuda hain — kam trades par tune nahi kiye gaye. Chhote sample (< 20) par % par bharosa na karein.
